title: Make the practice run without you
summary: Capability work succeeds when it no longer depends on one person. Hand over ownership, build it into routines and step back.

beginner: List everything you do to keep the practice going.
Find an owner for each item.
Build key practices into normal routines, such as planning and reviews.
Hand over gradually and support the new owners.
Check after a few months that things still run.
intermediate: Make community leaders and coaches self-sufficient.
Write down how the practice is run.
experienced: Embed product practice into how the organisation is managed.
Grow the next generation of practice leaders.
Plan your own exit from the work.

toolExamples.confluence: Document how the practice runs and who owns each part.

definitionOfDone: Owner for each part of the practice
pitfalls: Staying the single point of failure
